description: This file defines the TargetMetrics interface, which provides metrics and JSON serialization methods related to a Target, including address metrics, schema version, and message counts.

classes.name: TargetMetrics
classes.description: An interface exposing metrics about a Target, including methods for JSON serialization and retrieving address metrics.

classes.name: TargetMetrics.JsonFields
classes.description: An immutable inner class defining JSON field definitions for schema version, address metrics, and published messages.

methods.name: getAddressMetrics
methods.description: Returns a map of address strings to AddressMetric objects, representing metrics for each target.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the TargetMetrics object into a JsonObject, including only non hidden marked fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the TargetMetrics object into a JsonObject with a specific schema version and field selector.
